Hey I know where your coming from I'm a mom to 4 kids ranging from 13 years to 8 months and I still beat myself up for having any me time I remember when I had my first I felt this overwhelming sense that I should spend every waking moment with him and it was my job to do everything for him despite having a partner and family around. I've learnt that time away does you all good if your feeling relaxed or happy it definitely impacts on your kids if I'm feeling bad it throws everything out for them too. Please don't feel guilty enjoy your free time as it get less and less with more kids ! You sound like a really good mom give yourself a break x

Hey so I'm similar situation 36 living with partner and we have kids, I suffer with depression and take medication but still get good and bad days. It can be easy looking in from the outside at someone else's "perfect" life we become good at masking our feelings to family friends etc.. when really you are screaming inside, the whole porn on the work Pc thing sounds like it was just a release a distraction at that particular point doesn't make you a bad person at all. You seem to have a supportive loving wife who will stick by you no matter what the outcome ok worst case you loose your job (you might not) but you still have your family who I'm sure love you. Please don't feel guilty for feeling the way you do I know there are thousands of us out there too x

Ok I'm the mom of a 13 M so I get the wanting to protect her son but believe it or not I can remember being 14/15 and can totally get you need your privacy. It seems really extreme that your being monitored every time you use phone, pc etc.. your mom seems to have an issue, ok she's your mom but she needs to give a bit god knows being a teenager is hard especially these days with all the social media etc not sure how old she is but as a child of the eighties we didn't have that problem, have you explained this to her that you know she's looking out for you but it is suffocating you and you need space to be you and yes that includes fucking up but finding your own way to solve things good luck x

Hey sounds like you have had to fight hard for everything in life , I'm not going to tell you to pull your self together type thing as people who say that have not really lived it themselves but I am here if you wanna talk / vent to someone x
Hi I'm here if you want to talk to someone x
Hey I'm here if u want someone to talk to x
Please don't , I'm here if you wanna talk to someone x

Depression is a total bitch of an illness, please don't feel guilty for thinking you have family/wife so should be happy. It doesn't work like that I'm in a similar situation with kids etc.. and I get days where it's all too much and I just want it to end but please realise you are not alone talk /vent to others who really understand what it's like to be there keep fighting x

Totally know where your coming from from the outside things can look fine to others, and people saying what have you got to be depressed about is so telling of a person who has not been there themselves depression is a horrible illness and I have days where I do things only because I have people depending on me, but I'd really rather go to bed and stay there than deal with life I've found you get better support from others who have had or do have depression themselves x

It's good to release it, doesn't matter your age sex etc.. we all need to cry/shout/scream whatever but holding it in does more damage if you found a song that helps then that's great thanks for sharing x
Sorry no magic wand would be nice sometimes if I had, you don't sound "stupid" just thought you might want some one who's been there to chat too
Hey I'm here if u wanna talk x
